item.title: Xbox Cloud Gaming Pay‑As‑You‑Go: 10‑Hour for $3.99
item.description: Microsoft rolls out a pay‑as‑you‑go Xbox Cloud Gaming model, with 10‑hour, 25‑hour and 50‑hour bundles starting at $3.99, launching November.
